console.name: milo-client
console.title: OPC UA Client
console.description: OPC UA client connections and their refused monitored items

endpointUri.description: The OPC UA server endpoint, with its password masked

routeIds.description: The ids of the routes whose consumers use the connection

sessionActive.description: Whether the session with the server is active

monitoredNodes.description: The number of nodes that have a monitored item on the server

status.description: The status of the latest attempt to create the monitored item of the node: the refusal, or the failure of the attempt

reason.description: Why the client refused the node without asking the server (only present when it did)

refusedNodes.description: The nodes whose monitored item was refused, which are created again every reconnectTimeout milliseconds
